name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.77.0 — `scope-reconcile.js`'s at-risk candidate walk skips `fixtures`/`__fixtures__` directories exactly as it skips `node_modules` (specs/20260903/07-test-file-budget-guard.md D8, AC-20260903-07-7): prose and data fixtures under a test tree that mention a changed file's path are no longer handed to the host `testCommand` as tests, so a diff touching `package.json` no longer reddens the at-risk leg on two Markdown files; changed-file classification is untouched. Host-side in the same spec (no plugin surface): `scripts/test-file-budget-reporter.js`, a node:test reporter wired into `npm test` and `testCommand` that fails any file over 45 s serial (`__FILE_BUDGET_RED__`), plus the tournament and build-driver test files split into shards. 7.76.0 — `/spec:status`'s default screen becomes exactly four blocks — 🗺️ Roadmap (unchanged), 🎯 Next (the paste line, ⏳ branch lines only when the top pick is blocked), up to three ⚠️ decide lines, and a one-line footer (specs/20260903/05-status-diet.md): every anomaly gains an `audience: "decide"|"hygiene"` field, computed once in code — `skipped-brief`/`out-of-order` are decide and additionally carry `line`/`ask`/`paste`; every other kind stays hygiene with its `detail` unchanged. The anomaly fold, the ⚠️ Anomalies section, the ⚡/🚦/🕓/⛔ lane render, and the 📡 observation block leave the default screen for a new `--all` flag (usage 2 combined with `--next`/`--brief`), which adds `📋 All open work` (today's lane render, verbatim) and `🧹 Hygiene (n) — /spec:doctor`. A red observation now renders as the `/spec:escape` Next line plus a 🔴 footer sentence carrying branch, sha and url — the 📡 block is gone. `--json`, `--next --json`, `--next`, `--pretty` and `--brief` stay byte-identical, plus the additive `audience` field. `/spec:doctor` check 13 reports hygiene anomalies as findings and decide anomalies as info. tests/status/status-diet.test.js, tests/spec-status.test.js, tests/status/red-alarm.test.js. 7.75.0 — reports write the queue instead of narrating deferred work in prose (specs/20260903/04-reports-write-the-queue.md): `report-render.js` gains an optional `queued: [string]` slot, rendered `📋 {text}` between `found` and `next` (`📋` joins `ANCHOR_GLYPHS`; an empty/absent array renders nothing, byte-identical to today). core.md § Console Output Style's Close the loop bullet now requires every deferred action — anything a report would tell the user to do later, or a new spec/brief judged to run before the current work — to be written via `spec-queue add …` before rendering (`--top` urgent, `--after-spec`/`--after-brief` gated) and listed under `queued`, never left as a sentence; /spec:plan's Lock step 2, /spec:review's DONE report and Close step, and /spec:escape's step 7 each cite the rule at their own deferred-work site. tests/report/report-render.test.js.
